# LOTO Photo Audit — Snak King — All departments

- **Run date:** 2026-10-16
- **Auditors:** loto-food-production-equipment-engineer + loto-snak-king-maintenance-engineer (consensus)
- **Tenant:** Snak King - COI (`ae3f1973-4c3e-4b6e-b91f-9de5ff10529e`) · project `zwtnpyjifbdytlektxlc`
- **Scope:** all active placards · **placards audited:** 499
- **Method:** the 939 cached photos are 202 distinct images (perceptual hash, Hamming ≤ 4); each distinct image was inspected once by the equipment engineer and judged against every placard slot that shows it, then each placard was reviewed in plant context by the maintenance engineer.
- **Access:** READ-ONLY (no production rows or storage objects were modified)

## Summary

| verdict | isolation photos | equipment photos |
|---|---|---|
| match | 9 | 26 |
| low_confidence | 136 | 202 |
| mismatch | 323 | 243 |
| missing | 31 | 28 |

Auditors agreed outright on 424 of 499 isolation verdicts; every disagreement was floored per the consensus rule.

**Headline:** only 9 of 499 isolation photos are confirmed to show that machine's own isolation point. 411 placards display an isolation photo shared with other machines (one image on 78 placards), and the dominant failure modes are another unit's tagged disconnect, an E-stop or pushbutton station, or no isolating device at all.

## Findings

### `SKAP-1001` — SKAP-1001 (SEAL CHECKER #10-1 - Automated Packaging) — Automated Packaging
- **Manufacturer / model:** (blank) / (blank)
- **Documented energy codes:** E, M, P
- **Equipment photo:** `mismatch` — Large Focke-style enclosed case packer (aluminum-framed guard doors, control cabinet, corrugated blank magazine at left) with machine number '15' on the top frame.
- **Isolation photo:** `mismatch` · shows_isolation_point=`true` · consistent_with_energy_steps=`false` — Gray Focke & Co control-cabinet door with a Focke & Co 'HFP' data plate, a black/gray rotary main switch (lockable type) in the center, a red mushroom E-stop, a door handle and a yellow warning label.
- **Consensus note:** engineer `mismatch`, maintenance `mismatch` — Main switch of a Focke HFP case packer cabinet, not a seal checker / scale isolation point; reused on 20 placards. Iso photo is the Focke HFP case-packer cabinet main switch, i.e. the isolation point for SKAP-1005 on this line, not seal checker #10-1 (equip photo is also the case packer marked 15); cross-wired within the line-10 case-packing cell.
- **Recommended fix:** Re-shoot the seal checker #10-1 local disconnect/main switch [VERIFY ON SITE: disconnect ID] and its pneumatic supply lockout valve at the FRL; move the Focke main-switch photo to the SKAP-1005 case packer placard.

### `SKAP-1003` — SKAP-1003 (ACP FEED CONVEYOR #10-3 - Automated Packaging) — Automated Packaging
- **Manufacturer / model:** (blank) / (blank)
- **Documented energy codes:** (none)
- **Equipment photo:** `low_confidence` — Stainless hooded discharge chute over a green modular plastic-belt incline conveyor with clear side guard; image rotated 90 degrees. No ID visible.
- **Isolation photo:** `mismatch` · shows_isolation_point=`false` · consistent_with_energy_steps=`false` — ProMach Performance Services operator station on a guarded elevator cell: panel number '1', tag '+J835', START/STOP/RESET pushbuttons, JOG UP/JOG DN buttons, AUTO/MAN selector, EMERGENCY stop mushroom and an 'Elevator Stack Light' legend. No disconnect handle visible; LOTO procedure sheet hanging on guard.
- **Consensus note:** engineer `mismatch`, maintenance `mismatch` — Pushbutton/E-stop operator station, not an energy-isolating device. Iso photo is a ProMach elevator operator station (pushbuttons/E-stop, no disconnect) belonging to the line-1 elevator conveyor (station '1'), a different line, not ACP feed conveyor #10-3; an E-stop is not an energy-isolating device. Placard has NO energy codes, so both EN and ES placards render with no energy steps.
- **Recommended fix:** Shoot the lockable disconnect feeding ACP feed conveyor #10-3 [VERIFY ON SITE: local motor disconnect vs. SKAP-1005 Focke cabinet feed] with the unit ID visible; move the ProMach station photo off this placard.
